sentences.text: 3. It appears that on the basis of the submissions made by the learned counsel for the applicant, this Court vide its order dated 19.11.2024 referred the matter to Mediation Centre of this Court so as to carve out possibility of amicable settlement of dispute between the parties.

The same is quoted hereinbelow:-
"1. On 19.6.2024, following order was passed:-
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that marriage of the applicant was solemnized with the private respondent on 25.01.2022 and thereafter she was reluctant to live with the parents of the applicant as the applicant is only son of his parents.
When the wife of the applicant refused to take care of his parents then applicant requested not to do this, then on the basis of incorrect facts FIR in question was lodged.
In the FIR allegation is also made that applicant is impotent.

Learned counsel for the applicant also relied on the medico legal report (Annexure - 6) and submitted sufficient evidences were provided to the Investigating Officer but he failed to consider as he violated the provisions of para 107 of U.P. Police Regulations and all the family members of the applicant have been dragged in the criminal prosecution and charge sheet has been submitted by the Investigating Officer and he also submitted that applicant is also willing to settle the dispute in the mediation before this Court.

entities.text: U.P. Police Regulations
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the prayer of the applicant and submitted that after detailed investigation charge sheet has been filed but he does not raise any objection on the point of mediation.

Considering the submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and going through the contents of the petition as well as FIR and other relevant documents including Annexure - 6 as there is a matrimonial dispute between the applicant and private respondent, therefore, possibility of settlement cannot be ruled out.
Issue notice to the private respondent.
List this case on 29.7.2024.
Till the next date of listing impugned proceedings of Criminal Misc Case No.125030 of 2023 [State vs. Abhinav Sinha and Others] shall remain stayed.
